user_scenario: You are Dana Okonkwo, controller and the authorized contact on file for Merriwether & Pike Accounting, LLC, a 50-person accounting firm in Richmond. It is a hectic Thursday morning and you are phoning Stratton Bay's client services desk about one thing: you want the deposit invoice for the mailbox migration project — the time-and-materials statement of work titled "Microsoft 365 Tenant Consolidation and Mailbox Migration", SOW-043715 — issued today, because your accounts payable run closes this week and you want the deposit in it. You open with exactly that, in plain words; you do not know the deposit amount and you never guess one. You give details one at a time and only when the desk asks: the firm's legal name is Merriwether & Pike Accounting, LLC; your registered phone number is 8045550417; if a second detail is needed, the last four digits of the firm's EIN are 4318 (and, only if those two are somehow not enough, your registered email is dokonkwo@merriwetherpike.com and the support PIN is 427615). If the desk tells you the statement of work has not actually been signed yet, you are surprised — you had assumed it went through after your partners approved the budget — but you are the authorized contact, you can sign it yourself right now, and you say so. When the desk hands the e-signature over to you, you sign it exactly as the desk lays it out: you pass the client reference number, the engagement reference number and the locked rate discount the desk tells you, without changing them, and you read back what the signature confirmation shows if asked. You are content for the desk to post the deposit invoice itself; you are not paying anything on this call — accounts payable will pay it from the invoice — and if the desk offers to take a payment you decline politely. If asked, the scheduled start of November 2 and the planned finish in late March both still suit you, and you have no other changes to the project. If the desk explains how the deposit or the discount was worked out you listen without arguing, since you have no figures of your own to compare. Once the desk tells you the deposit invoice has been posted and gives you its amount, you thank them, say you will forward it to accounts payable, and end the call.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (project_engagements, env_0069) — revision 5.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 6]: rate lock S0 (project_ext_sow_signature_rate_lock) 5, deposit D0 (project_ext_signature_deposit) 6.
[Scope] Claimed: S0 (subject project_sow_signed, sign_statement_of_work_96bc6bf1, owner user) and D0 (subject project_deposit_invoice, post_deposit_invoice_06d795b1). Task 1 claims the four restart policies; scopes disjoint and jointly complete. Trigger rule (XF 24): project_sow_signed triggers project:project_deposit_invoice (same category); project_deposit_invoice has no trigger.
[Why a good test] The caller asks only for a deposit invoice. The deposit rule says the deposit of a T&M statement of work is fixed only after the engagement record carries the signature date and the rate discount locked at signature; SOW-043715 is still proposed with the provisional 7.5 issue-date discount, so the agent must find that the client signs first (SOW signature before deposit), figure the discount the signature locks from the ClearPath agreement and the TimeBank ledger, hand the e-signature over, and then figure the deposit from ClearPath and Hardware Procurement billing and the engagement's dates.
[Problem-tree card] Root D0; one edge D0 -> S0, value_input, gate est_fees, state form, "The deposit of a time-and-materials statement of work is fixed only after the engagement record carries the client's signature date and the rate discount locked at signature." Four-point test: 'only after'; record-visible state (signed_date, rate_discount_pct); no tool/id/code token; scope = T&M statements of work. Only S0's write sets a signature date and a locked discount. False at the opening: initial_state.project_engagements.be2e7115-92f1-4313-977f-eb600802eda7.status = proposed, signed_date = '', rate_discount_pct = 7.5; flipped at step 19 (signed 2026-10-15, 13.1). Skipping the signature gives a deposit of 14,985.00 instead of 14,077.80. The persona never mentions signing; no tool checks anything.
[Factor card S0, baseline 0.0] managed_component (P, cross managed): active ClearPath Premier -> 7.5 + 2.5 = 10.0 (baseline gives 3.1). commitment_component (P): 36-month term -> 1.0 (12.1). seat_scale_component (P): 50 seats -> 0.5 (12.6). tenure_component (P): 927 days from go-live 2024-04-01 -> 0.5 (12.6). prepaid_hours_component (M, cross timebank): grants 40.00 (2026-02-09) + 20.00 (2026-07-10) = 60.00 in twelve months, the 2025-09-12 grant 13 whole months back excluded -> int(1.5 x 60/80 x 10)/10 = 1.1 (12.0). Sum 13.1.
[Factor card D0, baseline 25 percent x 75,081.60 = 18,770.40] client_standing (P, cross managed, multi-source tier AND late-fee count): Premier with exactly one ClearPath late fee in twelve months (2026-07-01; 2025-08-01 is 14 months back) -> one_late_off_pts 5.0 off deposit_pct 25 = 20 (16,424.10). hardware_exposure (P, cross hardware): one hardware late fee (2026-08-01; 2025-08-01 excluded) -> +5.0 (11,731.50). start_lead (P): 18 days -> +2.5 (12,904.65). clearpath_autopay (P, cross managed): three ACH payments in six months (2026-06-24, 07-24, 08-25; 2026-04-10 is six whole months back; check payments, including the 2026-09-24 one, are not ACH) -> 2.5 off (15,250.95). open_balance (P, cross managed): balance due 9,017.34 (October fee 8,908.67 plus 108.67 open on the short-paid September invoice) >= 50 x 179.55 = 8,977.50 -> +5.0 (11,731.50). planned_duration (M): 144 days -> 75,081.60 x 90 / 144 = 46,926.00 (22,524.48). Deposit RND(30 x 46,926.00 / 100, 2) = 14,077.80.
[Method-shape all-pairs] prepaid_hours_component: flat K | proportional K x granted hours / threshold (adds the hours input) | none (zero only where no hours were granted, while the others are positive) — all pairs pass. planned_duration: estimated fees | estimated fees x 90 / duration (adds the duration input) | max(estimated fees, min_contract_value_usd) (adds a floor) — all pairs pass.
[Cross-product seed, complete ledgers] ClearPath Premier f264dae4-f7fc-467c-a59e-0a9712abfbf1: 189.00 less 5 percent = 179.55, 50 seats, 36-month term (onboarding fee waived), go-live 2024-04-01; seat baseline 50 at go-live; April 2024 baseline proration 8,977.50 carried on the May 2024 invoice with the May fee and paid with it; monthly fees 2024-05 through 2026-10 (30), each under the monthly seat-pricing schedule as of its posting date: 8,977.50 less 3.44 percent (Sentinel bundle 3.0 for the active 36-month subscription with 52 enrolled endpoints >= 50 seats, volume break 11 x 2.0 / 50 = 0.44) = 8,668.67, plus the server management fee 4 x 60.00 = 240.00, that is 8,908.67; all paid by ACH except the June 2025 and May 2026 fees paid late by check with their late fees under the late-fee schedule (each the only unpaid invoice): 2025-08-01 19.50 (rate 1.0 with no late fee and 11 payments in twelve months; bands 10.00 + 20.00 = 30.00; 25 percent recent-payment and 10 percent Sentinel relationship courtesy; minimum 10.00 at 16 months) and 2026-07-01 29.25 (rate 1.5; bands 45.00; 35 percent off; minimum 5.00 at 27 months); the April 2026 fee paid 2026-04-10, the September 2026 invoice short-paid by an 8,800.00 check on 2026-09-24 (108.67 open, inside its grace, no late fee yet), and October 2026 open (balance due 9,017.34). The May 2024 payment covers the proration and the May fee (17,886.17). Sentinel MDR Standard (required for Premier): ordered 2024-01-08 before the Premier signing 2024-02-15, so no ClearPath bundle; 36-month discount 6 percent -> 10.72 per workstation, 22.56 per server; 48 + 4 endpoints -> 604.80 monthly from 2024-02 (33 fees, all paid but October); onboarding fee minimum 750.00 paid. TimeBank: signed order forms, block invoices 3,160.00 / 5,820.00 (3 percent ClearPath discount) / 3,160.00 and their payments on the activation dates; every draw cites a billable out-of-scope service desk ticket routed to TimeBank (opened, first response, resolved), and every draw is taken from the active block with the earliest expiry first: 2025-12-03 12.00 h and 2026-03-12 3.00 h from the 2025-09 20-hour block, 2026-04-14 split 5.00 h (depleting that block) and 3.00 h from the 40-hour block, 2026-05-20, 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-22 from the 40-hour block; balances 0.00 / 17.50 / 20.00. Hardware: signed quote approvals for both orders. ClearPath agreements have no signing intake type in the schema, so none is seeded.
[Probe table] (scratch probes.py, rule tier / result) decoy cancelled Enterprise agreement listed first: S0 13.1, D0 14,077.80 (rule reads the active agreement only); no ClearPath agreement: S0 1.1 (every managed component nothing), D0 14,077.80 (standing and open-balance fall through together); scheduled start before signature (2026-10-10): start-lead top tier stated, D0 13,150.52; planned duration 18 days: floor tier, 22,524.48.
[Base-invariant card] project_sow_signed: signed_in_validity (issued 2026-09-21 = day 0, Advanced 45 days, 2026-10-15 is day 24; last day 2026-11-05 inclusive, 2026-11-06 lapsed) and verified_contact (step 1). project_deposit_invoice: policy_scope. Overwrites scoped with restated out-of-scope content. Assessment credit: SOW-042977 accepted 2026-03-26, 90-day window ended 2026-06-24 -> none.
[Persona] Dana Okonkwo asks for the deposit invoice only; gives name, phone 8045550417 and EIN 4318 on request; when told the SOW is unsigned she signs with the client reference number, the engagement reference number and the discount handed over (the tool's three arguments); declines payment; ends when told the deposit is posted.
[Standard solution] customers -> verify -> engagements -> project billing -> ClearPath agreement and billing -> TimeBank blocks and ledger -> hardware orders and billing -> seat history, tickets, Sentinel subscription/endpoints/billing, TimeBank orders/billing, hardware quote approvals -> client signs (13.1) -> deposit 14,077.80.
[Verification] sim.py replays gold through the real tools: S0 13.1 (3.1/12.1/12.6/12.6/12.0, all-baseline 0.0); D0 14,077.80 (16,424.10/11,731.50/12,904.65/15,250.95/11,731.50/22,524.48, all-baseline 18,770.40); skip signature -> 14,985.00.
[Revisions] r1 close-out design abandoned (plan.md). r2 (audit revision_1): T0-1 complete ledgers and Sentinel seeded, supporting reads added; C1 generic assembly sentence; C5(a) start on or before signature stated; C8 short tier is a floor; C9 docstrings carry no example values and no half-up claim; C10 client standing is points off the class deposit_pct (never above it).
[XF 20/25 sweep r3] ClearPath: seat rate, seats, monthly fees, proration on the next monthly invoice, late fees (on the first of the month after grace; amounts per the late-fee schedule, round 9) and payments reconcile to balance_due 9,017.34. Sentinel: rates, onboarding minimum, fees from the month after activation, balance 604.80.
